description: This file defines the PersistableCustomerOption class, which extends CustomerOptionEntity and implements Serializable. It includes a list of CustomerOptionDescription objects and provides getter and setter methods for this list.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerOption
classes.description: A serializable class representing a customer option that can be persisted, containing descriptions and extending CustomerOptionEntity.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of CustomerOptionDescription objects associated with this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of CustomerOptionDescription objects associated with this customer option.
